title: Lighthouse
tagline: Hunt hidden ships by lamplight on a stormy headland.
blurb: Hide your fleet, then call shots into the fog while the lighthouse beam sweeps the water. Sink every hull before the Wrecker finds yours.
description: Battleship on a stormy night beneath a lighthouse. Lay out your fleet on a brass-framed chart, then take turns firing into your rival's fogbound waters as the beam swings round to light each shot. Misses splash beside a buoy, hits set timber burning, and a sinking ship breaks apart in a chain of explosions while lightning cracks over the sea. Three seas from a tight cove to the open ocean, storm, fog or moonlit weather, pass-the-device hotseat with a curtain between turns, or face the Wrecker, whose Captain keeps a probability chart of every place a ship could hide.
